title: Dead Men Tell No Tales: Assessing Post-Mortem Data Protection in GenAI Chatbots
reasoning: The research's primary focus is the ethical management and data protection of deceased individuals within GenAI systems. It evaluates chatbots based on ethical dilemmas surrounding 'deadbots' or 'griefbots,' post-mortem dignity, and psychological harm to survivors, proposing a framework of ethical principles (Right to be Forgotten, Data Inheritance, and Purpose Limits) to audit these systems.
